services.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapBrokerService
services.doc:
QuickSwapBrokerService administers a broker org, over ConnectRPC and REST.
 Every request names its broker. The caller is either the broker's API key,
 sent as a bearer token (see QuickSwapService), or a member's interactive
 session token; a person who is not a member of the broker gets NOT_FOUND /
 BROKER_NOT_FOUND. Each RPC maps to one broker action:

 | Action | Owner | Admin | Finance | Affiliate manager | Viewer | API key |
 | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 | Read (GetBroker, ListKeys, ListVaults, GetVault, ListMembers, ListQuickSwaps, GetQuickSwap, GetFeeTotals, GetBrokerStats, ListVaultBalances, ListPayouts, GetPayout, ListUpcomingPayouts, ListVaultPayoutRules, ListVaultLedger, ListVaultAllowlist, ListVaultAllowlistChanges) | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes, except ListMembers |
 | Create vaults (CreateAffiliateVault, SetVaultStatus) | yes | yes | no | yes | no | yes |
 | Manage keys (CreateKey, RotateKey, RevokeKey) | yes | yes | no | no | no | RotateKey of itself only |
 | Manage members (InviteMember, SetMemberRole, RemoveMember) | yes | yes, never the Owner | no | no | no | no |
 | Transfer ownership | yes | no | no | no | no | no |
 | Manage the payout address allowlist (RequestVaultAllowlistChange) | yes | no | yes | no | no | no |

 A member managing keys, members or the payout address allowlist must also
 send a fresh step-up proof in
 the X-Auth-Step-Up header, obtained by completing an MFA challenge for
 fresh step-up; each proof authorizes one change. Reads, vaults and a key
 rotating itself need none. A denied action fails with PERMISSION_DENIED /
 ACTION_DENIED, a missing or used proof with PERMISSION_DENIED /
 STEP_UP_REQUIRED.

 An API key's calls count against the broker's read_rps for the key. A
 member's session calls count against the member's account, across every
 broker the member belongs to: changes (vaults, keys, members, invites,
 ownership and the payout address allowlist) against the account's change
 quota, and reads against the account's own read rate. These limits are
 checked before the call runs, so a call they refuse changes nothing: over a
 limit it fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After
 header in seconds, and while a member's change quota cannot be checked, the
 change fails with UNAVAILABLE carrying a RateLimitDetail (REST: the message
 "rate limit authority unavailable"). Any other UNAVAILABLE on a change can
 leave its outcome unknown: read the state again before retrying it.

 REST errors are application/problem+json (see ErrorDetail) with the HTTP
 statuses of QuickSwapService, except that CreateKey and RotateKey answer
 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED with 504: the outcome is unknown and a retry may create
 another key, so list the broker's keys before retrying.

methods.name: CreateAffiliateVault
methods.doc:
CreateAffiliateVault creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with label.
 Create a vault before the first QuickSwap that credits it: a QuickSwap
 naming a vault that does not exist yet is refused. Concurrent and
 repeated requests with the same label return the same vault. No step-up
 proof is needed.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.
 - RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: BROKER_LIMIT, the broker's vault limit.

methods.name: CreateKey
methods.doc:
CreateKey creates an API key. A broker has at most two working keys.
 Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: KEY_LIMIT.

methods.name: GetBroker
methods.doc:
GetBroker returns the broker, its limits and current usage of them, and
 the caller's role.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: GetBrokerStats
methods.doc:
GetBrokerStats reads the broker's QuickSwap activity in a window.

 Per UTC day or month: QuickSwaps created by status, deposits credited
 and payouts delivered per asset, and the service, broker, affiliate and
 referral fees charged per asset.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INTERNAL: STATS_INCOMPLETE, with the swap_id of a QuickSwap whose
   records the stats cannot read.

methods.name: GetFeeTotals
methods.doc:
GetFeeTotals totals the broker and affiliate fees charged in a window.

 Fees charged to the broker's QuickSwaps, per asset, grouped by vault, day
 or month.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: vault_account_id is not a public sub-account ID.

methods.name: GetPayout
methods.doc:
GetPayout reads one payout run of the broker's vaults.

 For a detail view or a link from a ledger entry. Every broker role and
 the broker's API keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND, including a run of
   another broker's vault.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the payout cannot be read; retry the same request.

methods.name: GetQuickSwap
methods.doc:
GetQuickSwap returns the full detail of one of the broker's QuickSwaps.

 The detail includes its addresses, quote, progress, and requested and
 charged fees. Every broker member role can read it with a session token.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or SWAP_NOT_FOUND, including another
   broker's QuickSwap.

methods.name: GetVault
methods.doc:
GetVault returns one affiliate vault.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: InviteMember
methods.doc:
InviteMember invites a person with any role but OWNER; the person
 accepts with their own login. Inviting again replaces the pending invite.
 The invite stays pending only while the caller may still grant its role.
 Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND when the account does
   not exist.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: ALREADY_MEMBER.

methods.name: ListKeys
methods.doc:
ListKeys lists the broker's API keys, without secrets, a page at a time.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or malformed.

methods.name: ListMembers
methods.doc:
ListMembers lists the broker's members and pending invites. Session
 token only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.

methods.name: ListMyBrokers
methods.doc:
ListMyBrokers lists the caller's broker memberships and pending invites.

 Session token only.

 Errors:
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED for a broker API key.

methods.name: ListPayouts
methods.doc:
ListPayouts lists the payout runs of the broker's vaults.

 Newest first, filtered by vault, status and scheduled slot. Every broker
 role and the broker's API keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or VAULT_NOT_FOUND for a vault that is
   not the broker's.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker, other filters or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the payouts cannot be read; retry the same request.

methods.name: ListQuickSwaps
methods.doc:
ListQuickSwaps lists the broker's QuickSwaps.

 Newest first, filtered by vault, status and creation time.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: vault_account_id is not a public sub-account ID, or
   a page_token from another broker, other filters or malformed.

methods.name: ListUpcomingPayouts
methods.doc:
ListUpcomingPayouts previews the next payout run of each vault.

 The preview uses the vault's balances now: when the run starts, whether
 it would pay, and per asset what it would pay, what would stay and why,
 and the expected network fee. Every broker role and the broker's API keys
 can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault filter, or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: a preview cannot be read; no partial page is returned.

methods.name: ListVaultAllowlist
methods.doc:
ListVaultAllowlist reads one vault's payout address allowlist.

 The allowlist holds the destinations the vault's payouts and withdrawals
 may pay, each with when it becomes payable. A destination is payable 24
 hours after it is listed. Every broker role and the broker's API keys can
 read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the allowlist or the vault's payout rule cannot be read;
   no partial list is returned.

methods.name: ListVaultAllowlistChanges
methods.doc:
ListVaultAllowlistChanges lists one vault's payout address allowlist
 changes, newest first, pending ones included. Every broker role and the
 broker's API keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault, or
   malformed.

methods.name: ListVaultBalances
methods.doc:
ListVaultBalances reads the current balances of the broker's vaults.

 Covers the default vault and every affiliate vault. Every broker role
 and the broker's API keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault filter, or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: a balance cannot be read; no partial page is returned.

methods.name: ListVaultLedger
methods.doc:
ListVaultLedger lists the movements of the broker's vaults' funds.

 Newest first: each fee a QuickSwap credited, each payout that left a
 vault with how it ended, and each refund of a rejected payout to the
 vault's smart account. It carries no running balance; read the current
 balance with ListVaultBalances. Every broker role and the broker's API
 keys can read, without step-up.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND, or VAULT_NOT_FOUND for a vault that is
   not the broker's.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker, other filters or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: the ledger cannot be read; retry the same request.

methods.name: ListVaultPayoutRules
methods.doc:
ListVaultPayoutRules reads the payout rule of each of the broker's vaults.

 Each vault also lists the assets it holds or was credited in that its
 rule pays no destination for. Every broker role and the broker's API keys
 can read, without step-up; only Owner and Finance members change rules.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or vault filter, or
   malformed.
 - UNAVAILABLE: a rule or balance cannot be read; no partial page is
   returned.

methods.name: ListVaults
methods.doc:
ListVaults lists the broker's affiliate vaults.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: a page_token from another broker or malformed.

methods.name: RemoveMember
methods.doc:
RemoveMember removes a member, ending their access immediately, or
 cancels the person's pending invite. The Owner cannot be removed. A
 removed member's pending invites are cancelled in the same change.
 Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: OWNER_IMMUTABLE.

methods.name: RequestVaultAllowlistChange
methods.doc:
RequestVaultAllowlistChange adds a payout address to a vault's allowlist,
 or removes one.

 Only Owner and Finance members can, each change with its own fresh
 step-up proof. The change is returned PENDING; ListVaultAllowlistChanges
 shows how it ends. A vault has at most one pending change. An added
 destination becomes payable 24 hours after it is listed
 (VaultAllowlistEntry.payable_from).

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND;
   ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_NOT_LISTED for a removal.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - INVALID_ARGUMENT: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_INVALID, or a label on a
   removal or with leading or trailing whitespace.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_EXISTS.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: ALLOWLIST_FULL, ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_IN_USE,
   ALLOWLIST_CHANGE_PENDING or VAULT_ALLOWLIST_NOT_READY.
 - UNAVAILABLE: outcome unknown; read ListVaultAllowlistChanges before
   requesting again.

methods.name: RespondToInvite
methods.doc:
RespondToInvite accepts or declines a pending invite addressed to the
 caller. Session token only; no step-up proof is needed. An invite is
 accepted only while the member who sent it may still grant its role.
 SetMemberRole, RemoveMember and TransferOwnership cancel the invites
 they take that from; accepting any other such invite cancels it.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: INVITE_NOT_FOUND.
 - ALREADY_EXISTS: ALREADY_MEMBER.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: INVITE_VOID.

methods.name: RevokeKey
methods.doc:
RevokeKey revokes a key immediately. The broker's last key that works
 without an expiry cannot be revoked. Session token and step-up proof
 only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or KEY_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: LAST_KEY.

methods.name: RotateKey
methods.doc:
RotateKey replaces a working key by a new one. The old key keeps working
 until the overlap ends, then only the new key does. A broker API key may
 rotate itself without a step-up proof; a member needs a session token and
 step-up proof.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or KEY_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: KEY_LIMIT, when the broker would have more than
   two working keys during the overlap.

methods.name: SetMemberRole
methods.doc:
SetMemberRole changes a member's role to any role but OWNER. The Owner's
 role cannot be changed; transfer ownership instead. The member's pending
 invites that the new role may not grant are cancelled in the same
 change. Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
 - FAILED_PRECONDITION: OWNER_IMMUTABLE.

methods.name: SetVaultStatus
methods.doc:
SetVaultStatus enables or disables an affiliate vault for new
 QuickSwaps. No step-up proof is needed.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or VAULT_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED.

methods.name: TransferOwnership
methods.doc:
TransferOwnership makes another member the Owner of the broker.

 The caller, the current Owner, becomes an Admin in the same change, and
 the caller's pending invites that an Admin may not grant (Finance) are
 cancelled. Session token and step-up proof only.

 Errors:
 - NOT_FOUND: BROKER_NOT_FOUND or MEMBER_NOT_FOUND.
 - PERMISSION_DENIED: ACTION_DENIED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED.
